GOOD TO KNOW

A few things before you begin.

Do I need equipment?

No. The workouts are designed for your floor and your bodyweight. A mat is optional.

I’m a beginner. Can I join?

Yes. Go at your pace, take breaks, and use the easier option when you need it. If an exercise causes pain, stop and seek professional guidance.

How long does the 14-day challenge take?

The video sessions are planned at roughly 10–14 minutes. Exact lengths will appear with each finished video.

Can I ask Eliana a question?

Yes. You can email her at elianaa.sue@gmail.com. Guide buyers are offered priority responses.

What are the access and refund terms?

These will be finalized and shown before the 14-day challenge goes on sale. For the existing guide, Gumroad displays the applicable terms at checkout.
